title: A category row can be remapped to any account, including 6400
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure AccountingHub is enabled for the organization and the test location has no QuickBooks Online connection.
custom_steps:
1. Open Accounting > Account Mappings.
  2. Pick 6400 Shop Equipment Maintenance in the "Internal: General Internal" row.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The rows show.

Step 2:

  • 6400 Shop Equipment Maintenance shows in the row.

Step 3:

  • The mapping is saved.

Step 4:

  • "Internal: General Internal" still shows 6400 Shop Equipment Maintenance.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11763 (Story 6, AccountingHub account mapping)

  • S6-R3: “The accountant can change any category row to any account in the chart, including the existing 6400 Shop Equipment Maintenance account where appropriate, as the other rows allow, and can add accounts to the chart as today.”
